title: Necessary noise bound for even exponents
statement: Let $S=\{-1,1\}$ have the uniform probability distribution, let $X(s)=s$, let $r$ be a positive integer, and let $\rho$ be real. Suppose that for every $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^{2r}$ norm of $a+\rho bX$ is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $a+bX$. Then $\rho^2\leq 1/(2r-1)$.
hypotheses_covered: For all real $a,b$, the stated uniform norm inequality holds
